messages:
maya: Morning — I'm scheduling an entitlement batch remediation next Tue morning. Scope: remove ~70 stale admin grants across prod projects, reconcile KMS key owners, and tighten audit log filters. Need volunteers for KMS report, canary/rollback plan, and on-call coverage. @ashley can you run the KMS owner inventory? @ricardo can you own canaries?

ashley: yep. I'll kick off the KMS inventory now and post results here. quick command I use: 
```
gcloud kms keys list --locations=global --keyring=prod --format='table(name, primaryKeyVersion.state,labels,labels.owner)'
```
I'll also query IAM bindings for obvious admin roles: 
```
gcloud projects get-iam-policy PROJECT_ID --flatten=bindings[] --format='table(bindings.role, bindings.members)'
```

access-audit-bot: Access Audit Report: automated scan found 68 potential stale admin grants across projects: prod-core (22), prod-ml (15), infra (31). Detailed CSV attached: https://internal.re/redwood/audit/1748002345.csv

ricardo: I can run canary plan. Proposal: 10% of services in prod-core as canary, 1-hour observation window, automatic re-add if error rate > 2% or latency spike > 50ms. Also recommend converting removals that touch infra accounts to conditional denials first (`condition` with `request.time` to expire in 7d) for lower risk.

liam: Are KMS audit logs enabled for all projects? If not, I'll enable CMEK key usage logs for prod-ml and prod-core so we can validate key-owner effects post-change. Also we should ensure service accounts with KMS access are on the list.

ashley: KMS owner report (excerpt): 
```
projects/proj-prod-core/locations/global/keyRings/kr-main/cryptoKeys/key-api -> owners: user:maya@redwood.com, serviceAccount:svc-ml@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
projects/proj-prod-ml/locations/global/keyRings/kr-ml/cryptoKeys/key-train -> owners: user:ricardo@redwood.com, user:ashley@redwood.com
```
I'll attach full CSV to the ticket.

maya: nice. Plan for next steps: 1) Ashley posts full CSV + proposed removals PR by EOD Fri, 2) Ricardo runs canary config and provides rollback playbook, 3) Liam enables/validates KMS audit logs and confirms SA list, 4) I'll publish runbook and notify #incidents + on-call.

liam: I can be on-call for the Tue morning window. I'll enable the logs now and ping when done. :thumbsup:

ricardo: I'll draft the rollback snippets. Smoke tests will include: `curl -sS https://health.service.internal/ready` (3x), auth flows for admin console, and token-bound checks for KMS decrypt ops. If anything fails, rollback is: re-add binding or revert to `condition` state from backup policy.

ashley: PR created: https://git.internal/re/rbac/prs/421 (contains CSV + proposed removals + diff). Tagging reviewers: @maya @liam. I've also added a column for 'confidence' (low/med/high) so we can stagger.

maya: thanks. I'll schedule the dry-run Tue 08:00 PT and full remediation 09:30 PT if dry-run is clean. Adding to Confluence runbook: https://confluence.internal/display/SEC/Entitlement+Batch+Remediation

access-audit-bot: Reminder scheduled: run post-remediation audit at +2h and +24h.

liam: logs enabled and validated for prod-core and prod-ml. Confirmed SA list includes svc-ml and svc-deploy.

maya: perfect. who will own post-run analysis for false positives? ricardo?

ricardo: I will. I'll compile a short findings doc and tag owners for re-approval if needed.

maya: great — thanks everyone. I'll push escalation contact list to the runbook and post a summary in #ops before Tue. :white_check_mark:
